originalSources.arrayQuantileAndBisectSource: Preserved in the complete unmodified d3-array 3.2.5 distribution segment; no separately prepared array source directory is claimed.

profileDifferences: Finite-number queries on finite source domains with n>=2 are the intended exact rank comparison profile; rank uses original right-bisect lo=1 and all duplicates.
Empty original domains call the interpolator with negative zero; singleton original domains call it with NaN. Neither is silently rewritten as unknown in this oracle.
Original JS domain coercion retains infinities, ignores null/undefined/NaN, and coerces strings/booleans/valueOf objects; query coercion and exceptions are preserved separately.
quantiles(0), noninteger/negative/coerced counts are retained native profiles, not proposed typed Rust contracts; unsafe unbounded requested lengths are never executed.
Finite input quantiles may produce nonfinite numeric results at extreme spans; all raw outputs remain encoded, not removed or assigned extra tolerance.
No Rust color implementation, consumer, legend, GPU/worker, or browser compatibility result is claimed by this candidate.
